question: What do the satisfied goddesses of consciousness do after consuming the universe as nectar?
premises: The goddesses of consciousness become satisfied.
Bhairava rests solely in the full heart of their own self as the sky of consciousness.
They repose upon that Bhairava without difference.
inference: After assimilation, the powers of consciousness come to rest in nondual union with Bhairava, the space of awareness.
plain_english: Satisfied, they repose without difference upon the god Bhairava, the sky of consciousness, who rests solely in the full heart of their own self.
